name: omniswarm
description: Multichain multi-agent security review suite for Solana, NEAR, Rust, Python, TypeScript, and Web3 systems

scripts.check: bash -n bin/audit && bash -n scripts/orchestrate.sh && bash -n scripts/sandbox.sh && npm test
scripts.test:intake: node tools/gate.mjs test:intake backend/intake/package.json -- npm test --workspace backend/intake
scripts.test:landing: node tools/gate.mjs test:landing frontend/landing/package.json -- npm test --workspace frontend/landing
scripts.test:contract: node tools/gate.mjs test:contract contracts/review-registry/Cargo.toml -- cargo test --manifest-path contracts/review-registry/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:e2e: node tools/gate.mjs test:e2e e2e/package.json -- npm test --prefix e2e --
scripts.check:infra: node tools/gate.mjs check:infra infra/check.sh -- bash infra/check.sh
scripts.eval:golden: node tools/gate.mjs eval:golden eval/run.mjs -- node eval/run.mjs
scripts.check:all: npm run test:schemas && npm run test:intake && npm run test:landing && npm run test:contract && npm run test:e2e && npm run check:infra && node scripts/harness.mjs --self-test && npm test
scripts.check:w01: node --test scripts/reviewer-*.test.mjs scripts/orchestrator-phases.test.mjs scripts/run-config.test.mjs && node scripts/harness.mjs --self-test && npm test
scripts.check:w02: node scripts/harness.mjs --self-test && npm test && OMNI_REQUIRE_HARDENING=1 node --test scripts/sandbox-hardening.docker.mjs scripts/review-workflow.docker.mjs
scripts.check:w11: npm test --workspace frontend/landing && npm run guard --workspace frontend/landing
scripts.check:w13: npm test --workspace packages/guard && node demos/attack/run.mjs && node demos/attack/run.mjs --no-guard
scripts.check:w14: node tools/gate.mjs check:w14 --pending "W14 is not built yet; its wave replaces this script"
